text:
[NextItNet](https://arxiv.org/abs/1808.05163) uses dilated causal convolutions and residual blocks, providing natural intervention sites at block inputs, convolution outputs and residual additions. Dataset evidence cautions against equating recommendation accuracy with temporal reasoning: a [2024 study](https://arxiv.org/abs/2408.12008) found weak sequential structure in several popular datasets through shuffling experiments; a [2026 preprint](https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.07125) identifies local-transition shortcuts and limited dependence on long histories. These findings motivate endpoint-controlled probes but do not establish shortcuts in this particular trained model.

[Activation-patching best practices, ICLR 2024](https://arxiv.org/abs/2309.16042), show that corruption methods and measurement choices can substantially change localization results. A practical adaptation: preserve the final item, item multiset, sequence length and padding while permuting earlier valid positions; separately change the endpoint while holding the prefix fixed. Cache clean activations and patch individual blocks or temporal positions into the counterfactual run; reverse patching direction to examine complementary effects. Measure target-versus-negative score margins and paired validation HR@10 changes, retaining identical candidates. A [2026 attribution-patching preprint](https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09899) warns that gradient approximations can misidentify components because of downstream nonlinearities; confirm important findings with actual forward interventions.

Proposed calibration, rather than an established NextItNet-specific protocol: inject known faults into temporary diagnostic copies—incorrect count-minus-one readout, disabled residual branches, or contaminated padding—and test whether probes localize them. Include identity patches, repeated-history controls, causal receptive-field checks and explicit final-nonpadding readout assertions. Intervention effects establish sensitivity under the chosen manipulation; calling history harmful additionally requires reliable improvement in target ranking when that information is removed or corrected. All probes can operate within each category’s single trained network.
